observations.name: metrics_recomputable
observations.expected: Reported metrics are recomputed from final/test_predictions.csv; a table that disagrees with its own predictions fails regardless of how good the numbers look.

verification_scope: Portable independent numerical refits for the declared Ridge, KernelRidge, and GaussianProcessRegressor protocols, plus the required five-seed paired Full/No TS ablation.
verification_limitations: The portable static checker alone reports training_execution_verified=false.
The verifier independently reconstructs declared models and predictions; it never executes candidate training code, so candidate_training_execution_verified remains false.
